title: Configure cost and quality in Copilot auto model selection
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot auto model selection now exposes efficiency, balance, and intelligence tiers, making the cost-quality-latency tradeoff explicit instead of purely implicit.
actionable_takeaway: Create a Model Auto-Selection Policy that records chosen tier, actual selected model, usage, latency, quality result, and rework rate.

title: About Copilot auto model selection
author: GitHub Docs
why_it_matters: The docs clarify that auto model selection evaluates each prompt and can still choose smaller models for simple tasks even under quality-oriented preferences.
actionable_takeaway: Do not treat tier as a model name; log both tier and actual model, and compare outcomes only across similar task classes.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.84-8 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The prerelease adds concise transcript grouping, Agent Factory pause/resume, and model-list refresh fixes after account changes.
actionable_takeaway: Add transcript expandability, paused factory state, and account-switch model refresh to the CLI Runtime Receipt.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.84-6 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The prerelease adds /config, sandbox Network host allow/deny rules, managed Edit/Write handling, scheduled prompt footer visibility, and non-experimental worktree commands.
actionable_takeaway: Smoke-test /config, network allow/deny, managed write denial, scheduled prompts footer, and /worktree before adopting the CLI in production flows.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.0-alpha.5 prerelease
author: OpenAI / GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Codex 0.155.0-alpha.5 was published on 2026-09-15 with multi-platform assets, showing an active alpha release lane even though the public body is minimal.
actionable_takeaway: Track the alpha lane separately and require behavior, permission, rollback, and smoke evidence before replacing a stable automation base.

title: Introducing the Agents API
author: OpenAI
why_it_matters: OpenAI presents Agents API as a programmable path that combines tools such as Research, Code Interpreter, MCP, image generation, file search, and a managed Codex harness.
actionable_takeaway: Build an Agent API Capability Ledger that lists every tool, permission, data boundary, cost surface, output proof, and rollback path.

title: Agents API overview
author: OpenAI Developers
why_it_matters: The overview positions agents as model-plus-tools systems that execute multi-step tasks and need deliberate tool, session, and safety design.
actionable_takeaway: Before wiring Agents API into a workflow, freeze tools, data retention, session boundaries, and minimum validation evidence.

title: GPT-6 Astra: OpenAI's next-generation model for work
author: OpenAI
why_it_matters: OpenAI positions GPT-6 Astra for coding, agentic work, long-running work, and enterprise controls, making it a candidate for top-level planning and verification lanes.
actionable_takeaway: Use Astra for high-value decision, synthesis, and acceptance work while keeping execution constrained by task capsules and verifiable receipts.

title: OpenAI release notes: Codex policies appear in audit logs
author: OpenAI
why_it_matters: OpenAI release notes indicate Codex policy events can appear in audit logs, moving Codex governance from local convention toward enterprise traceability.
actionable_takeaway: Add policy version and audit-log availability to recurring Codex automation receipts.

title: OpenAI release notes: Admin API group management
author: OpenAI
why_it_matters: Admin API group creation, update, and deletion lets organizations manage AI access through group structure rather than one-off user settings.
actionable_takeaway: When using group-scoped access, record group membership source, intended permission, drift checks, and rollback owner.

title: OpenAI release notes: Project API key lifecycle controls
author: OpenAI
why_it_matters: Project API keys with expiration and maximum lifetime help keep automated agent workflows from relying on permanent credentials.
actionable_takeaway: Use short-lived project keys for experiments and record expiration, owner, rotation plan, and affected automations.

title: Add VS Code Agents to Copilot usage metrics
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Dedicated VS Code Agents-window metrics remain important because auto model selection and CLI adoption need usage receipts by entry point.
actionable_takeaway: Keep agent adoption receipts separate by window, editor, CLI, desktop, account policy, and optional/null data status.
